text: Point Value (PV) is assigned to each product and is used to qualify for bonuses, recognition, achievements and incentives.
Personal Point Value (PPV) represents the total point value on all products you have purchased during the month.
Group Point Value (GPV) is your PV plus the QPV of all qualified directors in your first three levels.
A Qualified Director must have a director title and accumulate at least 4000 PV.
Qualified Directors earn 25% of the Charge Sale Volume Bonus.
To become a Manager, you need your own personal PV and you are eligible to earn a Sale Volume Bonus.
Leadership Development Bonus (LDB) is earned when you achieve the director title and produce a director in your team.
Network Development Bonus (NDB) is earned when you achieve your personal goal.
Neolife distributors are eligible to earn incentives including personal recognition gifts and travel rewards based on performance.
Neolife was founded by a man named Jerry Brassfield in 1958.
Neolife came to Nigeria in the year 2001.
Wealth is defined as having an abundance of valuable resources or assets.
A Full Distributor stage requires 250–499 PV and earns 3% bonus.
A Manager stage requires 500–799 PV and earns 5% bonus.
Senior Manager stage requires 1000–1799 PV and earns 10% bonus.
Executive Manager stage requires 2000–2799 PV and earns 15–20% bonus.
Director stage requires 4000+ PV and earns 25% bonus.
Emerald Director requires 4000–10,000 PV.
Sapphire Director requires 10,000–19,999 PV.
NeoLife does not rely on traditional paid advertising; instead it rewards distributors for spreading the word.
Your unique NeoLife ID number is valid for 160 years.
The three core activities NeoLife expects from distributors are: Use the Products, Share the Products, and Share the Opportunity.
The Financial Status Ladder has five levels: Financial Crisis, Financial Instability, Financial Stability, Financial Independence, and Financial Freedom.
Duplication (training one person who then trains others) is presented as a key strategy for growing business.
